fields.name: State
fields.evidence: ecl::splitscreen::IsSplit (EoCClient.dll+0x84AAD0) returns (*(byte*)component & 0x24) != 0; ecl::splitscreen::AnimationSystem::Update (EoCClient.dll+0x852000) writes single-bit values 2, 4, 0x20 to this byte and tests masks 0x1a (a one-hot animation state). Live: 2.

fields.name: _Pad1
fields.evidence: Only the low byte is read or written by AnimationSystem::Update and IsSplit; the macOS default constructor writes 8 bytes then zeroes +4.

fields.name: Progress
fields.evidence: AnimationSystem::Update sets +4 to 0.5 or 0.0 when the state changes, otherwise adds GameTime delta (param_2+8) and compares with 0.5 (animation timer in seconds). macOS default: str wzr, [x23, #4]. Live: 0.

open_questions: Meaning of each state bit (2 = merged?, 4, 0x20 = split per IsSplit mask 0x24) - would need an enum name; none found.
